
---
title: "Instacart Shopping Patterns"
output:
  flexdashboard::flex_dashboard:
    orientation: columns
    vertical_layout: fill
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(p8105.datasets)
library(plotly)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE
)

data("instacart", package = "p8105.datasets")

department_counts =
  instacart |>
  count(department, name = "product_records") |>
  mutate(
    department = fct_reorder(department, product_records)
  )
```

Column
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Product records by department

```{r}
department_counts |>
  plot_ly(
    x = ~product_records,
    y = ~department,
    type = "bar",
    orientation = "h"
  ) |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Number of product records"),
    yaxis = list(title = "", automargin = TRUE)
  )
```
